channel.title: Utsav Karki | Blog
channel.description: Web development, DevOps and freelancing notes by Utsav Karki.

item.title: From Itahari to St. John's: Balancing an MSc, a Dev Job and Freelance Clients
item.description: What changed when I moved from Nepal to St. John's, Newfoundland to study an MSc in Computer Science at MUN while working as a software developer and keeping my freelance clients.

item.title: Building verisultcollege.ca: A WordPress Site for a Canadian College
item.description: How I approached the verisultcollege.ca WordPress build at Verisult: information architecture for programs and admissions, performance, accessibility, SEO and a launch checklist.

item.title: Laravel Performance Optimization: From 5s to 200ms Load Time
item.description: A practical guide to optimizing Laravel applications: database indexing, eager loading, caching strategies and deployment best practices that took a dashboard from 5s to 200ms.

item.title: Production VPS Setup: Ubuntu, Nginx, PHP-FPM, MariaDB
item.description: Step-by-step guide to a production-ready Ubuntu VPS for PHP sites: users and SSH hardening, firewall, Nginx, PHP-FPM, MariaDB, free SSL with Certbot, and backups.

item.title: Working with UK Clients as a Remote Freelancer: Lessons from Nepal to Canada
item.description: Practical lessons from years of freelancing for UK businesses, first from Nepal and now from St. John's, Canada: communication, time zones, scoping, invoicing and long-term relationships.

item.title: WordPress Security Hardening: A Complete Checklist
item.description: A practical WordPress security checklist: updates, admin accounts and 2FA, file permissions, wp-config hardening, Nginx and .htaccess rules, a WAF, backups and malware monitoring.

item.title: NopCommerce Development: A Practical Guide
item.description: A practical guide to NopCommerce development: architecture, themes and Razor views, writing plugins, payment and email integrations, search, and deploying to IIS or Linux.

item.title: Python Automation Scripts for Web Developers
item.description: Useful Python automation scripts for web developers: broken link checking, uptime alerts, image optimisation, API-to-spreadsheet syncs and scheduling them with cron.
